text: The helper adds Assert.equal(actual.getAttribute("disabled"), expected.disabled) without a message. Its two existing deepEqual checks for child types and labels also lack messages. Each assertion needs its own expected-result diagnostic; the nearby sparse-attribute comment and task name do not supply it. The class check has a nonempty failure label but can state the expected class more clearly. This is scoped test feedback with no execution or unrelated assertion cleanup.
title: The folder-popup helper adds an attribute assertion without a message
